author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing made each fin a straight box split by a crossbar with a trapezoid cap, reading as two pencils or markers; the original's fins taper from a rounded heel to a wide blade and lie head-to-toe.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. Two tapered paddles with rounded heels and square-cornered blades, head-to-toe; matches the reference silhouette at 48.
omissions: Foot-pocket slots and blade ribs (a line inside a 10-14 wide fin cannot keep 8 from both walls).
lucide_reference: Rounded-rectangle corners; no fin glyph in Lucide.
